component.name: 3DS Forwarder
component.summary: Build 3DS CIAs that launch one game with its RetroArch core

description.p: Creates one installable CIA per game for a 3DS running Luma3DS. Each forwarder appears on the HOME menu with its own icon, banner and jingle, and launches the game directly with the matching RetroArch core, without bundling a whole RetroArch.

Artwork comes from SteamGridDB (icon, hero and logo), and a live preview shows how the forwarder will look on the console. Existing forwarders can be opened, edited and rebuilt under the same Title ID.
